meta.definition: Based on top-flight appearances in a Big-5 European league (England, Spain, Italy, Germany, France) or the Champions League — not every competition or level of football. A player qualifies with at least one such appearance for each club.
meta.inclusion: >=1 appearance for each club across Big-5 top-flight leagues + Champions League
